scientific_integrity: Exact analytic proof; reproducible numerical diagnostics are supplementary. The same-model review is not independent peer validation.
scientific_limitations: Annealed one-sided Poisson step gas only; Poisson clocks and return to each initial position; fixed-parameter tail limit; no quenched counting, interactions or uniform joint-limit theorem. The age-mixture method and independent-reset comparator are known.
title: Synchronization-induced current tails in a one-sided Brownian gas
